copy.strip-mask-mean-help: Give the checked bands their arithmetic mean light-time, including zero. Their combined light-time stays the same; unchecked bands, targets and the successive mask stay put. This edits the toy, not paper. Undo restores the whole press.

meanlight.message: meanlight preserves unrelated state and answers its supplied native experiment

copy.strip-light-sum-help: These add light-time across bands, not darkness across paper. Checking a band changes only the second sum; it does not expose anything.

sumlight.message: sumlight preserves unrelated state and answers its supplied native experiment
